meta.source: Kengxxiao/ArknightsGameData zh_CN (activity_table act2autochess + autoChessData, character_table, skill_table, range_table, battle_equip_table, uniequip_table)
meta.statFormula: Linear interpolation of character_table.phases[evolvePhase].attributesKeyFrames between keyframe levels; hp/atk/def/cost/block/respawn rounded half-up to int; + module attributeBlackboard at equipLevel (golden only). Potential 0, trust 0 (favorPoint 0). Talent-based permanent stat boosts NOT folded in (listed in talents).
meta.rangeGridFormat: [row, col] offsets, operator at [0,0], col>0 = facing direction (range_table direction=1 means facing right). Rotate for other facings.
meta.skillLevelNote: skill level 4 for normal chess, 7 for golden (精锐) chess (no masteries)
meta.garrisonNote: garrisons[0] is the displayed 特质 text; further entries are implementation components (apply all, display first). Markers like 【145】 in component text = internal reference to parent garrison id; ignore.
meta.skillTriggerNote: Resolve order: charId+skillIndex row, then subProfessionId row, then profession row (skillIndex 0 in those rows treated as wildcard), else DEFAULT. Wiki rule: offensive skills fire when an enemy is in skill range; defensive (TANK/TAKE_DAMAGE) when receiving damage; heals when an ally in range is injured.
meta.hiddenNote: isHidden chess are not in the current shop pool (上半期 leftovers / moved tiers); chess_char_1_15_a is granted by band effect aceffect_band_42.

skill.name: 终幕·浩劫
skill.description: 浮游单元+2，攻击力+60%，释放特殊形态的浮游单元散开后在整个战场范围各自追逐较近的敌人，追上时使目标恐惧2秒并锁定其攻击，浮游单元周围的敌人移动速度-40%且每秒受到相当于攻击力100%的法术伤害（不叠加）；浮游单元在锁定目标倒下后重新索敌，直至技能结束后返回干员身边
